newsitem.title: USA: Investcorp takes 51 pct stake in CSK Auto. [CORRECTED 17:32 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Investcorp takes 51 pct stake in CSK Auto. [CORRECTED 17:32 GMT]

text.p: International investment group Investcorp said on Tuesday (corrects from Monday) it agreed to acquire a 51 percent contolling interest in CSK Auto Inc, one of the largest retailers of automotive aftermarket parts and accessories in the United States, for an undisclosed sum.
The company said it expected the transaction to be completed within the next 30 days.

Investcorp said it had arranged a $125 million working capital facility and the CSK owners would make another $50 million off-balance sheet real estate facility available to support an accelerated store expansion program.
Arizona-based CSK Auto operates stores under trade names Checker, Schuck's and Kragen in 14 western U.S. states.
For the last 12 months, CSK Auto generated sales of more than $770 million, the company said.
Investcorp said CSK Auto ownership would hold the remaining 49 percent interest in the company.

"The acquisition of CSK Auto is consistent with our investment philosophy -- focusing on companies possessing recognized brand or trade names with a strong strategic position, significant growth opportunities and an excellent management team," said Savio Tung, a member of Investcorp's management committee.
